notes.title: Duck Paradox - 10 Tricks the Game Doesn’t Tell You
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=C0S-xcn2LfQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Duck Paradox is a fast-paced roguelite where every bullet is a threat — including your own. In this video, we break down 10 essential tricks and hidden mechanics that can change how you play the game. Whether you're a new player or halfway through fixing the timeline, this guide will help you master some of the game's most confusing (and coolest) systems.

We'll cover everything from vulnerability frames during your dash, to how to unlock new Duckling Upgrades, travel between dimensions, and even craft the secret items needed to beat the final boss. These are things the game doesn’t explain directly— but once you know them, everything clicks.

If you’re looking to survive longer, unlock more Ducks, and discover all the hidden content in Duck Paradox, this video is for you.

notes.title: Duck Paradox in the Steam Awards
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

The Steam Awards are going on and I hope you will consider nominating Duck Paradox for the “Best Game You Suck At Award”. 

Our intentions for Duck Paradox were always rooted in difficulty, actually as near as impossible as we could achieve. We wanted to express the dedication to a fruitless pursuit, one that is so crucial to your existence, that there is no other choice than to persist. Dr. Paraducks must save her pet, Quark. There is no other choice for her. 

Thank you so much for your support of Duck Paradox. Your feedback, endless runs, and support mean the world to us! We appreciate your vote!

Diego & the Magic Games team

notes.title: Disco Dimension Update!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2058150/Duck_Paradox/


Hello Ducklings,

Today is an exciting day as we introduce a new addition to Duck Paradox - The Disco Dimension! This update adds 12 levels, new and exciting mechanics, secret areas, and a second boss. The Disco Dimension is a whole new world to explore, along with the initial Lab Dimension (which has also seen some updates.)

From Diego Lenero, our lead developer: [i]“The Disco Dimension started out when our Audio Engineer and Composer, Adam Brown, said he wanted to make disco music. We got to work on a main mechanic - the Mega Disco Ball. Inspired by Atari's "Breakout" but with the bullet hell difficulty of Duck Paradox, we wanted to create the feeling of being inside a groovy pinball machine…while 40 corrupted ducks try to kill you.” [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42615924/fe764a7ae913cd0d77be0a1f020eaa9cb501f8ba.gif[/img]

You might be asking - “How do I get to the Disco Dimension?” Great question, we've broken it down here:

[olist]
[*] Explore secret areas and use Krono time to uncover a new item: Krono Shard. (Hint: You’ll need 3.)
[*] Defeat El Alicanteronte on Level 8 and retrieve its beak.
[*] Once you have all 3 Krono Shards and the beak, they combine to create the "Rift Slasher" dash upgrade. This rift damages nearby enemies and allows Dr. Paraducks to pass through an obstacle called Energy Walls, scattered throughout the Lab Dimension. This is a really fun new ability and we hope you enjoy it as much as we do!
[*] Behind the Energy Walls, you’ll find the elusive Disco Flower. If, during the level, you take Quark to the Disco Flower, he will transform into Disco Quark, and the Time Machine will begin to glow blue. Returning Disco Quark to the time machine will enter you into the Disco Dimension on the next level. Here, the new adventure begins!
[*] To finish all of the available content you’ll lastly need to find the final Disco Flower on the final level of the second loop just before El Alicanteronte to access the new boss El Rey Patoteca. 
[/olist]
This dimension takes some work to unlock, which makes your arrival that much more anticipated. We think this adds more variety of gameplay, skills to master, and a bigger piece of the time warp structure to explore. We want to hear your questions and feedback as we work towards full release. Feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/whMAgfCkuF]Discord[/url] or let us know in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2058150/discussions/]Steam Community tab[/url].

-Duck Paradox Team

notes.title: Duck Paradox 0.5.2 Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

The team has been hard at work on some updates that are going live in Duck Paradox today. As always we want your feedback. Feel free to drop any notes or thoughts in our Discord or over in the Steam Discussion tab.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2058150/Duck_Paradox/


[b]New Duckling Upgrade: Druid Duck[/b] - All Kronits recharge +5 more energy to the player

[b]New Enemy: Demon Duck[/b] - The higher level you reach in a run, the more chance these enemies have of spawning from an explosive egg. They can also be found in the Lab sandbox, so you can practice taking them down!

[b]New “Peek” Mechanic[/b] - Hold “Down” to move the camera lower, so you can see the dangers you may or may not be jumping into!

[b]New stat tracker [/b]- At the end of every run, a pop-up appears to notify the player how well they performed. Certain stats (bullets shot, enemy ducks killed, etc.) will have their totals tracked from run to run, and displayed in the Hubworld!

[b]Improvements to UI and Tutorialization[/b]
Animations assist in directing the player to Quark, then back to the time machine
The tutorial has been redesigned to offer new players a smoother introduction to the game's mechanics.

[b]Improvements to the Lab area[/b]
[list]
[*] Expanded areas and features
[*] New “Dispenser” entity - allows players to spawn different things such as Upgrades and shields for them to experiment
[/list]
[b]Late Game and consecutive Loops difficulty[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve also made numerous balance tweaks and optimizations. Improvements have been made to the difficulty curve for higher levels. Players that were getting very far in a run will find some new surprises.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Duck Paradox Update and News!
notes.notes:
Hey Duck Paradox Crew,

We are thrilled to share some quacktastic news! 🦆

Today we are dropping a massive update that's going to shape the future of our game. On March 14, Duck Paradox will release the first build of a brand new world and transition from a free to a paid game in Early Access.

But here's the deal: For all of you already dodging bullets and saving ducks as part of our community, you're already in. We have ensured that this update will be our gift to you, as a thank you for your early adoption, constructive feedback, and invaluable support. So, do not purchase the game again! If Duck Paradox is already in your library - simply download the update, and you're all set. You will continue to get new builds for free all the way through our 1.0 release. 

Think of what you've played so far as just the tip of the beak! We are enlisting more help to bring fresh adventures, big challenges, and, of course, paradoxes to future releases. You'll soon be enjoying new levels, way more ducks, and plenty of surprises.The new game will rollout with several drops from now until our final game release targeted for later this year.

Lastly, we are also happy to announce that we will be partnering with Midwest Games as the Publisher for Duck Paradox. This has already had some positive impacts on the game including QA, marketing, and extra resources to help in development! 

The Duck Paradox you know is about to get a whole lot bigger, and we cannot wait to hear your feedback. We could not have done this without your initial support. 

Stay tuned, stay quacky!
Magic Games and Midwest Games

notes.title: Patch Notes (Disco Dimension)
notes.notes:
[h1][b]We hope you are having fun playing the Disco Dimension![/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42615924/ea2ef456094ec675cfd6bfebb36803e0252c75c6.png[/img]

While you were at it, the dev team sat down and bug-fixed some of the things that were causing you to die or rage-quit the game. We believe that the gameplay experience is at beak point (kekw) right now and would be super excited to know if you think the same!

[h2][b]Here are the changes inside the patch:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[h3][*][b]DiscoBoss´s graphics are 100% crispier![/b][/h3]
After the release, we noticed that the DiscoBoss was being rendered a bit blurred by the Disco Dimension... Maybe the mad scientist that trapped us there was behind it? Anyways, you can enjoy a better look of him and other characters in the world now!

[h3][*][b]Unlock Disco Dimension right away![/b][/h3]
We noticed that some players didn't have access to the Disco Dimension right after updating on Steam, even if they already had completed the first dimension. From now on, you can always access the first level of both dimensions, even if your progress of the game is at 0%.

[h3][*][b]Invisible collisions are gone now![/b][/h3]
Some people were saying that the DiscoBullet was bouncing off objects it should not be bouncing off, such as clouds. We investigated the case and one of the ducks discovered some invisible bullets in the game! Turns out, when colliding with the DiscoBall, some bullets were becoming invisible and bouncing around the levels. This should not be a problem anymore!

[h3][*][b]The Eggs...[/b][/h3]
If you noticed, the Disco Dimension is home to a new entity. Cute colored eggs hatch in the levels and depending on the color, they spawn enemies or shields. 
Little but problematic were they... We discovered that sometimes, they can disappear the whole map and let you fall into the abyss! Also, they were not bright enough. Oh and the shields from the golden ones didn't work. Everything should be fixed now!

[h3][*][b]Big ducks don't go through gates anymore![/b][/h3]
A user on Steam told us that some of the big ducks were able to fly right through some gates. This is unacceptable! They should only be able to randomly spawn out of nowhere and make your life impossible... Fixed!

[h3][*][b]Music andn vfx are always smoother![/b][/h3]
We also improved some of the transitions for music and sounds, and it should give you the interdimensional experience you deserve.
[/list]
Thank you so much for helping us finding bugs, suggesting features and specially for playing the game! Our community is growing a lot and our Discord is becoming a very special place where we build the game together. We have tons of plans to upgrade the server and make it a game development home. Would love to see you there!
[h3][b]Join the Discord and build the upcoming features with us![/b][/h3]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/74D8fPnMPX][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2058150/extras/DiscordBanner.png?t=1660236353[/img][/url]

notes.title: Duck Paradox Launch!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=q1qRC152_aE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

This is our first game, we are determined to learn as much as possible to become better at making games and that includes working on different projects. This game was born in a game jam and we decided to continue working on it because we realized how much fun it can be and how much more it can become. If the community wants more of it, we will be happy to expand on it before moving on to another project. That is precisely why we included an endless survival mode apart from the 10 Story levels, we want to give players enough playroom to imagine what else this game could be and then carefully listen to them to decide what to do next.
